transloadit_assembly_completed_trigger.description: Runs each time an assembly is completed in Transloadit. Ones completed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, created, ok, error, template_id

transloadit_assembly_failed_trigger.description: Runs each time an assembly is failed in Transloadit. Ones failed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, created, ok, error, template_id
